description: Defines the rrc_reestablishment_procedure class for handling RRC reestablishment procedures in a 5G NR RRC context, including methods for security verification, context transfer, and signaling.

classes.name: rrc_reestablishment_procedure
classes.description: Class encapsulating the RRC reestablishment procedure logic, including security, context transfer, signaling, and fallback handling.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the reestablishment procedure asynchronously within a coroutine context.

methods.name: is_reestablishment_accepted
methods.description: Checks whether the reestablishment request has been accepted.

methods.name: verify_security_context
methods.description: Verifies the security context and updates keys based on ShortMAC-I.

methods.name: transfer_reestablishment_context_and_update_keys
methods.description: Transfers UE capabilities and updates security keys during reestablishment.

methods.name: create_srb1
methods.description: Instructs the DU to create the SRB1 bearer.

methods.name: send_rrc_reestablishment
methods.description: Sends the RRC Reestablishment message as per 3GPP TS 36.331.
